context.exploration_scope: Drift detection vs. E40's fixed baseline (same baseline E41 used, not shifted forward); reacts only to real, new drift, never fabricates it

problem: E41 exercised the drift-detection mechanism once and found 0 drift; whether it remains correct and non-fabricating on a 2nd independent run against the same fixed baseline had not been re-confirmed.

decision.decision_summary: Re-ran drift detection against E40's same fixed baseline. Changes found: 0. Conclusion: NO_NEW_EVOLUTION_FOUND. 0 candidates -- no real drift to react to.

action.action_summary: Fresh-read comparison against E40's fixed baseline; Gate evaluated only if real drift existed; 0 code modifications this run.

result.note: No real project change has occurred since E40 -- correctly concluded NO_NEW_EVOLUTION_FOUND rather than forcing a candidate to prove the mechanism "does something".

cause.root_cause_summary: The real project state has remained stable since E40/E41 -- no real Goal/Capability/Trace/Priority/Currency change has actually occurred to react to.

lesson: A drift-detection mechanism proves its own honesty precisely by returning the same true "no drift" answer on a 2nd independent run against an unchanged real baseline -- forcing a different result to appear more active would have been the actual failure mode here.
